build_rma_agent: build an RMA agent with memory, image reconstructions, and A2C loss for reinforcement learning
create_image_encoder_decoder: create an image encoder/decoder module that encodes images to latent codes and decodes back
unroll_rnn_core: unroll an RNN core over a sequence of inputs using static RNN unrolling
create_policy_module: create a policy module with MLP heads for action selection and baseline value estimation
compute_rma_loss: compute the total RMA loss combining A2C, reconstruction, and read regularization losses
